items.title: Meta’s Muse Is BLOWING Minds…. But At What Cost?
items.summary: Meta has officially launched Muse, a powerful new personal agent that is completely transforming how consumers interact with AI. During a recent episode of The AI Investor Podcast, Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith discussed the massive launch and why it sent the stock surging 12% to trade near all-time highs. Unlike previous consumer AI models that struggled with resource limits, Muse delivers secure, sandboxed personal environments with dedicated virtual machines and private browsers to keep your data completely locked down. With active users skyrocketing at a historic pace and even major publications praising its seamless capabilities, consumer-agentic AI has officially arrived. Eric and Austin also looked at the broader tech rally - including Intel's major moves- to discuss the privacy trade-offs, security concerns, and real-world use cases that every investor needs to know.
